entities.summary: Klaudio Ndoja is a retired Albanian-Italian professional basketball player. He last played for JuveCaserta. He was a member of the Albania national team in 2012 for the EuroBasket 2013 qualifiers. He is currently the coach of the Albania women's national basketball team.
